0022600142.text: The Mavericks, 2-2 overall and 0-1 at home, host the undefeated Oklahoma City Thunder (4-0, on a four-game win streak) in Dallas' fifth game of the season, with Dallas 3rd in the Southwest and 7th in the West while Oklahoma City leads the Northwest and the West. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin, Dereck Lively II, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, and Kyrie Irving and Naji Marshall are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso, Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh and Thomas Sorber, with Ajay Mitchell day-to-day, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after Dallas lost all three games to the Thunder in 2025-26, most recently 100-87 in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
